3D Printing

Welcome to the 3D Printing section! Here you'll find projects, tips, and resources related to 3D printing.

My 3D Printer

Ender 3 v2: My main printer for all my projects. Reliable, precise, and easy to use.

My 3D Printing Settings

  • Print Temperature: 210°C for PLA+, 200–205°C for Silk PLA (glossy finish)
  • Bed Temperature: 60°C for PLA+ and Silk PLA
  • Print Speed: 50mm/s normally, 30mm/s for detailed models, up to 75mm/s for quick prints
  • Supports: Tree supports for overhangs and complex geometries
  • Infill: 20% for most prints, 30%+ for functional parts
  • Cooling: Enabled for PLA+ and Silk PLA; fan speed 100% after first few layers

My 3D Printing Software

I use Cura for slicing, MakerLab for custom designs, Tinkercad for beginner-friendly modeling, Printables for downloading community models, and OctoPrint to control prints remotely via OctoEverywhere.

Welcome to the Bose 321 Section

This section is dedicated to the Bose 321 home theater system.

Overview of Bose 321

The Bose 321 is a compact home theater system delivering powerful, immersive sound. I recently acquired an original system over 20 years old, and it still works perfectly. Despite lacking HDMI and expansion options, the Acoustimass subwoofer and stereo speakers produce clear, rich audio that outperforms modern TV speakers. The CD/DVD player is convenient and supports Audio and Data CDs, while the built-in FM/AM tuner works well even with simple antennas. The system includes three sets of RCA inputs, allowing multiple devices like a TV or phone to connect simultaneously. Setup is extremely simple—just connect power and speakers—and it’s ready to use immediately. Overall, the Bose 321 provides excellent sound quality, versatility, and ease of use. For questions or concerns, you can reach me at Ljsneed11@gmail.com.

This file exists solely to respond to /search URL with the related search layout template.

No content shown here is rendered, all content is based in the template layouts/page/search.html

Setting a very low sitemap priority will tell search engines this is not important content.

This implementation uses Fusejs, jquery and mark.js

Initial setup

Search depends on additional output content type of JSON in config.toml

[outputs]
  home = ["HTML", "JSON"]

Searching additional fileds

To search additional fields defined in front matter, you must add it in 2 places.
